verdict.rationale: The public business search lets anyone look up registered entities by Filing ID or name, view entity details, and get PDFs of entity filings. Good-standing certificates can also be validated at no cost, giving founders public visibility into an entity's standing. However, nothing shows a way to track the processing status of a pending filing, application, or case (for example a submitted formation, amendment, or reinstatement under review). Missing for 10: status tracking for in-process filings and applications, documentation of which status fields the search shows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the lookup.
